entities.summary: Alberto de Palacio y Elissague (1856–1939) was a Spanish engineer and architect born in Sare and grown up in Gordexola. He studied architecture in Barcelona and completed his education in Paris, studying mathematics, engineering, astronomy and medicine. He was also a student & disciple of Gustave Eiffel.
